risk_note: Admin console orders read-only pages (apps/admin; no money logic beyond display; codex-run classed it RV2 because App.tsx is touched, so the Codex review ran on the money track). Contract CT-24m (adminListOrders, adminGetOrder; planned, backend not done, developed against the contract with a fake server); visuals per the finalized specs design/specs/admin-orders.md / admin-order-detail.md. List /orders with filters (paid date range by day, Beijing time; paid_to exclusive), money via @couli/money admin format, masked or unattributed user, row action names, paging, states and 10403; detail subpage /orders/<uuid> only (other shapes still land on the placeholder), status card with both lock marks side by side, attribution, commission snapshot (fen, basis points), status history and link records, 20001 notice; write actions and the raw payload are not rendered (contract CT-24n / permission pending). Status display names only from the admin dictionary (codes shown while keys are missing). Frozen admin-search assertions synced first by test-change F1-06zo (#1045). Rule tests by Codex in two calls; Claude spec-test review r2 pass; red on the test machine (red/1: 27 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5; test machine browser/2 green and verify-fast/4 green after the rebase. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34 / 36). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 pass, one S2 (an amount above the safe integer range throws while rendering) tracked in followups

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagents: round 1 fail (3 S1: date-time range input vs the day picker, address-bar filters not required, hardcoded status names not caught; 4 S2) plus two frozen-test conflicts (admin-search handled by F1-06zo, dashboard by routing only UUID ids), round 2 pass after Codex round 2 (2 S2 carried into the implementation constraints)
